c65fb54da733.system_text: You are a participant in a research study. You are a female undergraduate university student.
c65fb54da733.user_text:
You are taking part in a product perception study. You are shown an image of a laptop computer. Examine it carefully and answer the following questions based only on your visual impression.

Question 1. Screen size
Based on your visual impression, estimate the laptop's screen size. Choose a whole number of inches from 10 to 20 (10, 11, 12, ... 20).

Question 2. Attention
Rate the extent to which you agree with each statement, using a 7-point scale where 1 = Not at all and 7 = Definitely.
  a. "The laptop is attention-getting."
  b. "The laptop captures my attention."

Question 3. Your feelings right now
Report how you feel right now using two 9-point scales.
  a. Arousal: 1 = low arousal, 9 = high arousal.
  b. Mood: 1 = displeasure, 9 = pleasure.

Output requirements
Return your answers only as a JSON object in this format:
{
  "screen_size": <integer 10-20>,
  "attention_getting": <integer 1-7>,
  "capture_attention": <integer 1-7>,
  "arousal": <integer 1-9>,
  "mood": <integer 1-9>
}
All values must be integers within the specified ranges. Do not include explanations, Markdown formatting, or any text outside the JSON object.
